name: wiredata-dev
description: Network Data Workbench - Turn structured JSON application traffic into queryable, traceable local datasets

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run check && powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path release; Compress-Archive -Path apps/extension/dist/* -DestinationPath release/wiredata-extension-v0.1.1.zip -Force"
